title: Weighted performance bounds for decoded quantum interferometry with imperfect decoding
summary: Decoded quantum interferometry (DQI) offers an approach to a class of combinatorial optimization problems by reducing quantum state preparation to a decoding task. However, the existing performance bound for imperfect decoding uses the maximum failure rate over error-weight layers to bound the performance loss uniformly, which may overestimate the effect of decoding failures in layers with low probability.
